python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='rosterkit/contacts.py'
t=open(p).read()
i=t.index('# ---')
t=t[:i]+'''def _check(students: List[Student]) -> None:
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    _check(students)
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    return _align([(one.display_name, one.section, one.email) for one in ordered])
'''
open(p,'w').write(t)
EOF
make check 2>&1 | tail -8 && make lint 2>&1 | tail -5; git add rosterkit/contacts.py tests/test_contacts.py && git diff --cached --stat
